review_rules: Similarity, translation, syncretism, theological identification and literal metaphysical identity are separate relation types.
Do not collapse culturally related gods into one entity solely because a comparative religion source pairs them.
Preserve each culture's own claims before adding cross-cultural mappings.
Developer commentary can document intended relationships without erasing contradictory in-world theology.
Identity casefiles should support answers at multiple levels: linguistic, religious, historical and metaphysical.
